newsitem.title: USA: Coastal to merge MedCost into joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Coastal to merge MedCost into joint venture.

text.p: Coastal Physician Group Inc said on Wednesday it executed a definitive agreement to merge one of its managed care companies, MedCost Inc, into a joint venture between North Carolina Baptist Hospital and Carolinas HealthCare System.
Coastal said it would realize about $14 million in net pre-tax cash proceeds from the transaction, which will be used mostly to reduce bank debt.
The proposed transaction was expected to close before the end of November and was subject to certain approvals. Specific terms of the deal were not disclosed.

"This is the third transaction announced in conjunction with the implementation of our action plan to divest non-core assets in order to meet our debt obligations," said Henry Murphy, Coastal president and chief executive officer.
Based in Winston-Salem, N.C., MedCost owns and operates preferred provider organization networks and utilization management programs.
